newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: KREKENAVOS AGRO Q1 SALES 10.6 MLN LITAS.
newsitem.headline: KREKENAVOS AGRO Q1 SALES 10.6 MLN LITAS.

text.p: Lithuania's Krekenavos Agro said on Wednesday that its first quarter 1997 sales rose to 10.6 million litas from 6.5 million litas a year before.
He said the company expected to preserve the present level of sales during the second quarter of the year and to get a 700,000 litas net profit.

"Our sales increased by 4.1 million litas to 10.6 million litas during the first quarter of 1997 compared to the same period last year," director general of the company, Alfredas Stekeliunas, told Reuters.
"Meat prices rose considerably in a year and our sales show an increase in money although production output remained nearly on the same level," Stekeliunas added.
Stekeliunas also said that the company was investing in the Kedainiai tinned products factory and into plant growing sector during the three month of the year and the comany had no profit.
"We had no losses in the first quarter," Stekeliunas said although he refused to give a precise figure.
"Our plans might be interrupted by an increase in fuel and energy prices which may eventually lead to an increase in the price on our products," Stekeliunas added.
Krekenavos is traded on the A group of Vilnius bourse.
